author: Inside Edition
description: New video shows a baby left alone on the beach while her parents went on a stroll with their three other kids. A 911 call was made by a woman who was sunbathing. She told police she was startled to see the baby napping under a tent with no adult around. Deputies from Walton County, Florida, were met by the witness. Finally, the parents returned. Deputies say they had been home for about 56 minutes. The parents were charged with child neglect.
title: Parents Left Baby Alone On Beach For Almost An Hour, Authorities Say

author: Inside Edition
description: Notorious Gilgo Beach serial killer Rex Heuermann was sentenced after admitting the slaying of eight women. For the first time since his arrest three years ago, Heuermann spoke out in court. Heuermann was once a New York architect, but he was leading a sinister double life as a killer. "You're a disgusting, small man if you are a man at all, and you're a coward," the judge said to him. Heuermann was sentenced to life in prison without parole.
title: Gilgo Beach Serial Killer Rex Heuermann Sentenced To Life In Prison

author: Inside Edition
description: Archaeologists in Boston are searching for artifacts from the Battle of Bunker Hill. As they dig, pan and sift, they're getting an assist from veterans. The team is especially focused on defensive positions occupied by colonial forces. They're finding musketballs and other traces of the famous fight against the British. Joe Bagley, City of Boston Archaeologist, told reporters, "Though the Americans lost that battle, it galvanized the entire colonies against the British."
title: Veterans Find Old Musket Balls At Battle Of Bunker Hill Site

author: Inside Edition
description: A suspect was arrested after he allegedly pointed and fired his gun at a police drone. According to the Lee County Sheriff's Department, their Drone as First Responder is a new technology they've implemented to help protect and serve residents. They say the suspect fired two rounds in the direction of the aircraft as it was being used to assist the officers with a call. That's when they stepped in. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Suspect Arrested In Florida After Allegedly Shooting At Police Drone
